schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates into one PR per repo instead of one per package

Group major updates by manager instead of one PR per package — this is the fix for the 18-PR fan-out found on redacted 2026-08-10, where every major landed as its own PR despite dependencyDashboard-style grouping already being configured for minors
Automerge devDependencies once CI is green — they don't run in production, so a bad bump breaks the build loudly rather than shipping
Automerge patch bumps on any dependency type once CI is green — semver-safe by convention
